claims.statement: Both Rust (src-tauri/src/merge.rs) and TypeScript (src/utils/merge.ts) implement build_merged_content(lines, choices) with identical logic: Equal always included; Added excluded only on Left; Removed excluded only on Right; Modified picks original_content (Left) or content (Right); default (no choice) = Right behavior.

Tauri command build_merged_content_cmd exposes merge to frontend; web fallback uses local buildMergedContent; DiffView renders per-line merge buttons (→ for Left, ← for Right) on Added/Removed/Modified lines.

Merge mode state in App.tsx: mergeChoices Record<lineIndex, MergeChoice> updated on button click; mergedContent debounced via invoke() with requestId guard; Merge View shows editable Editor with merged result; Save writes via native dialog.
No traditional conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>) are inserted; merge is visual per-hunk with real-time preview; final output is clean merged text.
